name: Zotero Safe Edit
description: Lets local applications propose edits to Zotero items, which are applied only after approval in Zotero, with backups, a change log and undo.

name: Zotero Fix Proposals
description: Shows fixes proposed for Zotero groups (e.g. by the IPBES Literature Report) and applies the ones you choose through Zotero Safe Edit, after approval.
